title: Understanding Singular Values
text: When you apply PCA, the singular values represent the amount of variance captured by each principal component. Think about how these values relate to the total variance in the dataset.

title: Total Variance in PCA
text: Consider how the total variance of a dataset is distributed among the principal components. How does this relate to the sum of the singular values?

title: Exploring the Relationship
text: If the singular values represent the variance captured by each component, what does their sum represent?
